title: Clarify CSV rerun blockers
summary: Adds an explicit CSV rerun blocker explanation to the Launch rerun preview summary and button tooltip, backed by focused static coverage.
reason: The CSV rerun preview exposed blocked row counts and raw row reasons, but the visible status did not translate all-row lifecycle blockers into an operator-readable cause.
behavior_before: A blocked CSV rerun preview could show only a generic blocked status plus aggregate counts, leaving operators to infer that selected destination/original policies were the conflict.
behavior_after: Blocked CSV rerun previews now show a Why blocked section explaining that the selected rerun lifecycle policy, such as final replacement or original-source action, conflicts with the executable CSV rerun safety boundary and lists safe settings to retry.
tests_added: Focused static assertions in tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static_launch.py pin the CSV rerun blocker explainer strings.
rollback_plan: Remove rerunPreviewConflictLines, remove the Why blocked lines from rerunSummaryLines/button tooltip handling, and revert the focused static assertions.
notes:
Show explicit CSV rerun blocker explanation in the Launch rerun UI.
Pin CSV rerun blocker explanation strings in static Launch coverage.
